q30.
event: memo created → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (activity type `memos.memo.created`) — called from `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`
event: memo updated → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (activity type `memos.memo.updated`) — called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:67`
event: memo deleted → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (activity type `memos.memo.deleted`) — called from `DeleteMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:562`
event: memo comment created → `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (activity type `memos.memo.comment.created`) — called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:119`

All four are defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, and the first three funnel through the shared helper `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48-74`), while the comment one builds its own payload inline. Every one of them ultimately calls `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184-196`), which enqueues the payload onto a bounded channel (`asyncPostQueue`) consumed by a pool of 4 background goroutines that call `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120-180`) — this is where the actual HTTP delivery (signing + `safeClient.Do`) happens. So delivery converges on `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, reached asynchronously via `webhook.PostAsync`.
